name: Forbes Global 2000 (3-year average rank)

columns.name: forbes_id
columns.description: Stable id derived from Forbes URL slug.

columns.name: rank_3y_avg
columns.description: Average across the last 3 published Forbes Global 2000 lists. Lower = larger.

connector.notes:
Production connector would scrape forbes.com/lists/global2000/ across the
last 3 published lists and average ranks. For the prototype this is a small
static sample (8 entities) so the runtime can execute end-to-end without
network calls.

compiler_notes: Forbes does not currently publish a clean bulk download — the connector is a scrape. A real deployment would add fallback to manual_upload if the page structure changes.

Methodology says approx 50% of LobbyMap-tracked companies rank higher than 500 and approx 70% higher than 1000 (line 270). These are descriptive, not hard cutoffs — applied as soft filters in the next stage (tracked_entities), not here.
